_comment: Pronunciation overrides for terms Azure TTS mispronounces. Uses IPA notation in SSML <phoneme> tags. Add entries as you discover mispronunciations.

Keycloak.notes: Key-cloak, not 'KEY-cloak' with emphasis on wrong syllable.

Inertia.notes: Standard English pronunciation, but TTS sometimes stresses wrong syllable.

SocialiteController.notes: Break into two words for natural speech.

VOBsub.notes: Two words run together — pronounce as Vob-Sub.

AVPlayer.notes: Apple's media player. AV is the abbreviation.

PES.notes: Spell out: P-E-S. MPEG Packetized Elementary Stream.

ldid.notes: Lightweight code signing tool by saurik.

.NET.notes: Microsoft runtime. Not 'dot net' as two words.

AV1.notes: Video codec. Spell out A-V, then one.

AnalyserNode.notes: Web Audio API node. Break PascalCase.

EF Core.notes: Entity Framework Core. Spell out E-F.

Moooom.notes: Like 'moom' with a long 'oo'. Design system name.

Pest.notes: PHP testing framework. Like the word pest.

Reka UI.notes: Component library. Break into Reka + UI.

AAOA.notes: Spell out with periods to force letter-by-letter pronunciation.

nomercy-tv.notes: Project name. Hyphen + spell out TV.

a11y.notes: Numeronym for accessibility. Spell out the full word.

SaaS.notes: Software as a Service. Pronounced like the word sass.

FFmpeg.notes: F-F-mpeg. Two separate Fs then mpeg.

Fillz.notes: Human contributor name. Pronounced like fills.

terms._comment_encoder: Encoder / video / codec terms — added for The NoMercy Encoder report.

MP4.notes: Container format. Spell out M-P then 4.

CRF.notes: Constant Rate Factor. Spell out C-R-F.

NVENC.notes: NVIDIA's hardware video encoder. Pronounced en-vee-enc.

VideoToolbox.notes: Apple's media framework. Break into two words.

h264_nvenc.notes: NVIDIA's H.264 encoder handle in ffmpeg.

AAC.notes: Advanced Audio Coding. Spell out A-A-C.

PGS.notes: Presentation Graphics Stream — Blu Ray subtitle format.

ASS.notes: Advanced SubStation Alpha subtitle format. Spell out to avoid the other word.

AACS.notes: Advanced Access Content System. Blu Ray DRM.

VMAF.notes: Video Multimethod Assessment Fusion. Netflix quality metric.

CQ.notes: Constant Quality — rate control mode. Spell C-Q.

Hable.notes: Hable tonemap algorithm, named after John Hable.

AcoustID.notes: Audio fingerprint database. Spell out ID.

NVIDIA.notes: Pronounced en-VID-ee-uh, not spelled out. Same pattern for NVENC / NVDEC which are handled separately.

POST.notes: HTTP verb — pronounce as English word 'post', not spelled P-O-S-T.

GET.notes: HTTP verb — pronounce as English word 'get', not spelled G-E-T.

PUT.notes: HTTP verb — pronounce as English word 'put', not spelled P-U-T.

PATCH.notes: HTTP verb — pronounce as English word 'patch', not spelled P-A-T-C-H.

DELETE.notes: HTTP verb — pronounce as English word 'delete', not spelled D-E-L-E-T-E.

HEAD.notes: HTTP verb or Git HEAD — pronounce as English word 'head'.

messier.notes: English comparative of 'messy' — TTS was pronouncing it French (mess-ee-ay) after the astronomer Charles Messier.

G-E-T.notes: Legacy manual spell-out; fold back into the verb entry.

terms._comment_players_v2: Players V2 terms — added for Entry 009 The Shared Concern Call.

nomercy-player-kit.notes: Shared base package for the v2 player rewrite.

player-testbed.notes: Two words. Vue 3 reference consumer for the v2 API.

MediaSource.notes: Browser Media Source Extensions API. Break PascalCase.

P0.notes: Task priority level. P-zero is clearer than P-oh.

keyHandlerPlugin.ts.notes: TypeScript file. Break camelCase + spell out extension.

terms._comment_entry_010: Terms added for Entry 010 — The Feature That Belongs To No Repository.

register.ftl.notes: Keycloak login theme registration template filename.

realm-export.json.notes: Keycloak realm configuration filename. Matches the existing JSON pronunciation.

api.nomercy.tv.sub: A-P-I dot No Mercy dot T-V
api.nomercy.tv.notes: Production API domain. Dots read as 'dot', never silent.

auth.nomercy.tv.sub: auth dot No Mercy dot T-V

api-dev.nomercy.tv.sub: A-P-I dev dot No Mercy dot T-V

auth-dev.nomercy.tv.sub: auth dev dot No Mercy dot T-V

firstName.notes: Break camelCase into words. Keycloak required-attribute key.

lastName.notes: Break camelCase into words. Keycloak required-attribute key.

nomercy-stack.notes: Project name — Keycloak realm and login theme repo.

ERR_FAILED.notes: Chrome network error code, spoken without the leading 'net::' — that prefix is paraphrased away in prose instead of read literally.

geennoob.notes: Twitch streamer credited in Entry 010's With Thanks section. Dutch for 'not a noob' — narrate as the two spoken words 'geen noob', never spelled out letter by letter. Public handle, attribution requested by Stoney.

Riley.notes: First name only, credited in Entry 010's With Thanks section. RY-lee. No surname or handle on file — do not add one.

terms._comment_entry_011: Terms added for Entry 011 — One Tap, Three Wrong Outcomes.

ReportPositionCommand.notes: Break PascalCase into words. NoMercy Connect command that reports playback position; named in Entry 011's frontmatter components/commits, not spoken verbatim in the prose, added for future coverage.

MusicConnectPlugin.notes: Break PascalCase into words. The application-layer plugin described in Entry 011 as simply 'the Connect plugin'; named in frontmatter components, added for future coverage.

terms._comment_report_player_overrule: Web player trio terms — added for The Player You Can Overrule report (parts 0-3).

nomercy-player-core.notes: Shared headless foundation package for the player trio. Current v2-stable package name, no -v2 suffix.

nomercy-video-player.notes: Video player package built on nomercy-player-core. Current v2-stable package name, no -v2 suffix.

nomercy-music-player.notes: Music player package built on nomercy-player-core. Current v2-stable package name, no -v2 suffix.

eslint.notes: JavaScript linter. Spell E-S then lint, not 'ezlint'.

eslint-plugin-player.notes: Break hyphenated package name into words. Part 5, Guidance never walls.

beforePlay.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforePause.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeSeek.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeVolume.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeMute.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeRepeat.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeShuffle.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforePlaybackRate.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeLanguage.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeSubtitle.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeAudioTrack.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeDispose.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeTransfer.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player before-event hook, part 4.

beforeMutation.notes: Break camelCase into words. Player's generic state-mutation guard hook, part 4.

mutationGuards.notes: Break camelCase into words. setup() option controlling beforeMutation firing, part 4.

HOT_MUTATIONS.notes: Break SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE into spoken words. Constant array of mutation-guard-exempt method names, part 4.

TData.notes: Generic type parameter on BeforeEvent, part 4. Spell the T then say Data.

KMP.notes: Spell out: K-M-P. Kotlin Multiplatform, the app target. Entry 012.

HDMI_CEC.notes: Spell out fully. The signature|privileged Android permission. Entry 012.

eARC.notes: Say as 'e' then 'ARC' as a word, not spelled out. Enhanced Audio Return Channel. Entry 012.

ARC.notes: Read as the word 'ark', not spelled out. Sub is lowercase so edge-tts reads it as the plain word rather than spelling three letters. Audio Return Channel. Case-sensitive key — only matches the uppercase acronym in source text, never the agent name Arc. Entry 012.

CEC.notes: Spell out: C-E-C. Consumer Electronics Control. Entry 012.

AOSP.notes: Spell out: A-O-S-P. Android Open Source Project. Entry 012.

ADB.notes: Spell out: A-D-B. Android Debug Bridge. Entry 012.

dumpsys.notes: Two syllables, not 'dumps-is'. Android system-service dump tool. Entry 012.

logcat.notes: Two clean syllables. Android's logging tool. Entry 012.

MainActivity.notes: Break PascalCase into words. The app's entry Activity class. Entry 012.

onKeyDown.notes: Break camelCase into words. Android's key-event callback. Entry 012.

PhoneWindowManager.notes: Break PascalCase into words. The AOSP system-server class that intercepts hardware keys. Entry 012.

interceptKeyBeforeQueueing.notes: Break camelCase into words. The AOSP method that claims HDMI-ARC volume keys before app dispatch. Entry 012.

interceptKeyBeforeDispatching.notes: Break camelCase into words. The later AOSP method that MediaSession routing depends on. Entry 012.

handleVolumeKeyInArc.notes: Break camelCase into words, keep ARC as the acronym. The PhoneWindowManager method that owns the volume key in this entry's logs. Entry 012.

HdmiControlManager.notes: Spell H-D-M-I then say the rest as words. The system service that owns CEC, gated behind a signature permission. Entry 012.

VolumeProviderCompat.notes: Break PascalCase into words. The AndroidX class for MediaSession remote-volume routing. Entry 012.

isSystemAudioActivated.notes: Break camelCase into words. AOSP flag PhoneWindowManager checks before claiming the key. Entry 012.

hdmi_system_audio_control_enabled.notes: Break snake_case into words, spell the H-D-M-I prefix. The Settings.Global toggle, unreachable without the signature permission. Entry 012.

Gaat het niet zoals het moet, dan moet h.notes: Switch to Dutch voice for this entire phrase.
